HOMEPAGE.PART1TITLE: Enjoy the best beauty services at home
HOMEPAGE.PART1TEXT: Our qualified professionals come to you to offer quality beauty treatments tailored to your needs and desires. Experience unique well-being whether it's during your lunch break, after work in the evening, or during an afternoon with friends.
HOMEPAGE.PART2TITLE: Work when you want, earn on your terms
HOMEPAGE.PART2TEXT: Earn income on your own schedule by accepting requests on the platform at your own pace. You can use your own equipment or choose to rent professional equipment through izyGlam.
HOMEPAGE.PART3TITLE: A beauty service, reimagined for businesses
HOMEPAGE.PART3TEXT: Glam for Business is a platform designed for businesses of all sizes, tailored to manage the beauty needs of your clients and employees. Offer personalized beauty treatments directly at the workplace, during corporate events, or for special occasions. Our qualified professionals will come to provide services tailored to your needs.

CONFIDENTIAL.INTRO_BIS: When you use izyGlam, you entrust us with your personal data. We are committed to honoring your trust by protecting your information. This privacy statement describes the personal data (“data”) we collect, how we use and share it, and your choices in this regard. We advise you to read this document carefully.
CONFIDENTIAL.DECLARATION: This statement applies to users of the izyGlam platform, which connects individuals and businesses with independent beauty professionals such as nail technicians, pedicurists, makeup artists, and hairdressers. It covers all services offered by izyGlam worldwide.
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNAL: Personal Information (name, email address, phone number), account information (credentials, passwords, beauty service preferences), payment information (credit card details, banking information, transaction history)
CONFIDENTIAL.CREATE_DATA: Data Created During the Use of Our Services
CONFIDENTIAL.HISTORY: Browsing history, cookies, IP address, browser type, operating system, time spent on the platform
CONFIDENTIAL.DETAILS: Details about contacted beauty professionals, requested services, appointment times, exchanged communications
CONFIDENTIAL.BEST_SERVICES: Provide and improve our services, customize your experience, and process your orders
CONFIDENTIAL.PARTICULIER: Facilitate connections between individuals/businesses and independent beauty professionals
CONFIDENTIAL.SEND: Send you information about our products, services, special offers, and new features
CONFIDENTIAL.ASSURER: Ensure the security of our systems and prevent fraud
CONFIDENTIAL.EFFECTUER: Conduct analysis to understand platform usage trends
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNALISER: Customize your experience based on your preferences and usage history
CONFIDENTIAL.RGPD: Under the GDPR, you have the right to
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNAL_DATA_ACCESS: Access your personal data and request a copy
CONFIDENTIAL.ASK_CORRECTION: Request correction of incorrect or incomplete data
CONFIDENTIAL.ASK_DELETE: Request the deletion of your data (“right to be forgotten”)
CONFIDENTIAL.RESTREINDRE: Restrict or object to the processing of your data
CONFIDENTIAL.ASK_PORTA: Request the portability of your data to another service
CONFIDENTIAL.CONSENT: Withdraw your consent at any time where processing is based on consent
CONFIDENTIAL.RECLAMATION: File a complaint with a supervisory authority if you believe your rights are not being respected
CONFIDENTIAL.MANAGE_COOKIES_PREF: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings or a cookie management tool available on our site. In the future, izyGlam may use other technologies for tracking users.
CONFIDENTIAL.WE_SHARE: We share your personal data only with trusted third parties necessary for processing your orders and providing services such as
CONFIDENTIAL.FOURNISSEUR_SERV: Payment service providers for secure transaction processing
CONFIDENTIAL.TRANSPORT: Carriers or couriers for product delivery, if applicable
CONFIDENTIAL.MARKETING: Marketing and advertising service providers, only with your consent
CONFIDENTIAL.HEALTHCARE: Independent beauty professionals you have booked appointments with through the platform
CONFIDENTIAL.CLOUD: Cloud and hosting service providers to ensure the availability and security of our platform
CONFIDENTIAL.WE_SAVE: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected, including to meet any legal, accounting, or reporting requirements. Data is generally retained for 3 to 6 months.
CONFIDENTIAL.TECHNICAL: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. Among these measures, we use data encryption in transit and at rest, strong authentication for access to internal systems, and continuous monitoring of potential threats and security breaches. We have not yet implemented data breach response protocols, but this is something we are considering for the future.
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNAL_DATA: The personal data we collect may be transferred to and stored in countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA). When these transfers occur, we ensure they are carried out in accordance with applicable regulations using mechanisms such as the European Commission's approved standard contractual clauses.
CONFIDENTIAL.QUESTION: For any questions regarding our privacy policy or to exercise your rights, please contact us at: userprotection@izyglam.com
CONFIDENTIAL.RESERVES: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. In the event of significant changes, we will notify you by email. We encourage you to regularly review this page to stay informed of updates.
